summary: A Doha hospital dermatology page appears to lose appointments because its main booking link goes nowhere and no hours appear.

findings.problem: The main booking link, Call or WhatsApp, appears to link to #, and the Book Your Appointment Today heading appears to use # as well.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book have no working path.
findings.fix: A working call and WhatsApp link.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear anywhere on the page, and the phone number appears in three formats.
findings.cost: Patients cannot tell when to call or whether the number is correct.
findings.fix: Visible hours and one clean number.

findings.problem: Typos such as BACK TO DEPARMENTS, ALL RIGHT RESERVED and Weclome appear, and a doctor name appears spelled two ways.
findings.cost: Typos in a hospital page weaken trust.

findings.problem: No reviews, before and after examples or doctor experience details appear, and three booking headings appear to compete.
findings.cost: Patients choose a dermatologist they can see and trust.
findings.fix: Doctor profiles, reviews and one booking block.
